text: This report reviews and recommends approval of the application to amend the Official Plan and Zoning By-law to retain the existing 25-storey office building at the north west corner of Chestnut Street and Dundas Avenue West, and permit a new 59-storey and 53-storey linked mixed-use building (168.55 metres and 179.77 metres respectively, excluding mechanical penthouses), containing 1,551 dwelling units, 397 square metres of non-residential gross floor area, and a new 140 square metre Privately Owned Publicly-Accessible Space (POPS). The 15-storey office building at 123 Edward Street and the 6-level parking garage is proposed to be demolished.
